brush.why: Diacritic-stripped: the Bokmål word for brush is 'børste' (with ø), not 'borste'. NAOB lemma confirms 'børste'.

crow.why: crow = kråke (en; NAOB: kråke, kråker); 'krake' means a feeble creature/nag — wrong word

dryer.why: missing ø; correct spelling is tørketrommel (NAOB: tørketrommel, en, m)

hot-dog.why: Mid-phrase common noun wrongly capitalized; file convention is sentence-case for multiword entries (cf. 'Stekt kylling', 'Grønne bønner'). 'brød' is not a proper noun.

painting.why: s was the verb 'male' (to paint), not the noun. A painting = et maleri (neuter; malerier). Plural 'Malerier' was already correct.

ant.why: 'maur' takes a zero plural: en maur / flere maur. NAOB: 'en; mauren, maur'. Builder over-applied -er.

apple-tree.why: 'tre' (tree) pluralises with umlaut to 'trær'; compound epletre → epletrær. English is plural (Trees), so a real plural is required.

barrette.why: 'spenne' (buckle/clip) pluralises as 'spenner', not the agent-noun ending -ere. hårspenne → hårspenner.

beach.why: 'strand' has umlaut plural 'strender' (ei strand / flere strender), not 'strander'.

bow-tie.why: Head noun 'slips' is neuter with zero plural (et slips / flere slips). NAOB: 'et; slipset, slips'. So sløyfeslips is invariant in plural.

biscuit.why: 'kjeks' takes a zero plural: en kjeks / flere kjeks. Wiktionary Bokmål: indefinite plural 'kjeks'.

branch.why: Paradigm mismatch: singular is 'Gren', whose plural is 'grener' ('greiner' belongs to the variant stem 'grein'). Aligned plural to the given singular.

camel.why: 'kamel' keeps the -e- in plural: kameler, not the syncopated 'kamler'. NAOB: 'en; kamelen, kameler'.

candy-cane.why: 'stang' has umlaut plural 'stenger'; sukkerstang → sukkerstenger. Wiktionary Bokmål: indefinite plural 'stenger'.

carrot.why: 'rot' has umlaut plural 'røtter'; gulrot → gulrøtter. Wiktionary Bokmål confirms 'gulrøtter'.

brush.why: Diacritic-stripped stem; correct plural of 'børste' is 'børster'.

cherry-tree.why: tre (neuter) has irregular plural trær, not unchanged

coffee-table.why: plural mismatched singular stem (salongbord vs sofabord); salongbord is neuter → unchanged plural

colander.why: dørslag is neuter (et), plural unchanged (NAOB: et dørslag, dørslag)

comb.why: kam pluralises with double m: kammer (NAOB: kam, kammen, kammer)

cruise-ship.why: skip is neuter, plural unchanged (et skip → skip)

duck.why: and (duck) plural is ender (umlaut), not ander

goggles.why: Builder double-plural: singular 'vernebrille' pluralizes to 'vernebriller'; '-ere' is an over-applied second plural. s-field already holds 'Vernebriller' so p must match.

green-beans.why: 'bønne' pluralizes to 'bønner'; '-ere' is a spurious double plural (ART_DEFECT). Plural-picture, s='Grønne bønner'.

keyboard.why: Neuter English loan takes zero plural in bokmål (et keyboard, flere keyboard); builder over-applied '-er'.

lemon-tree.why: Countable, p===s but 'tre' pluralises to 'trær'; compound → sitrontrær.

mail-carrier.why: postbud is neuter (et postbud); base 'bud' has zero-plural (et; budet, bud), so postbud → postbud unchanged.

measuring-cup.why: Base 'beger' is neuter with plural 'begre'; compound målebeger → målebegre.

necktie.why: slips is neuter monosyllable with zero plural (et; slipset, slips).

overalls.why: Plural did not match its own singular 'Selebukse'; correct plural is selebukser.

picnic-table.why: Misspelled (Swedish-style ck) and 'bord' is neuter zero-plural; matches singular Piknikbord.
picnic-table.src: bokmål bord (et; bordet, bord); consistent with s

pliers.why: NAOB tang (redskap): en; tangen, tenger — irregular umlaut plural, not builder's regular -er.

pipe-wrench.why: Compound with -tang; plural of tang is tenger (NAOB), so rørtang -> rørtenger.

plum-tree.why: Head -tre (tree): et tre -> trær. Builder left plural unchanged; correct plural is -trær.

redbud-tree.why: Head -tre (tree): et tre -> trær. Plural was left unchanged; correct is -trær.

rain.why: regn is a neuter mass noun (NAOB: et; regnet, no flertall). Builder's -er plural is wrong; unchanged neuter form Regn.

shoulder.why: NAOB skulder: en; skulderen, skuldre. Builder over-applied -ere; correct plural is skuldre.

sneaker.why: Head -sko: en sko -> sko (zero plural). Builder over-applied -er; joggesko is unchanged in plural.

spoon.why: skje (utensil) plural is skjeer (en skje, skjeen, skjeer); builder dropped an -e

trowel.why: murskje = mur+skje; base skje plural skjeer -> murskjeer

sundae.why: beger is neuter, plural begre (et beger, begeret, begre); builder wrongly added -ere

theater.why: et teater, plural teatre (syncopated); -ere is not standard

thermometer.why: et termometer, plural termometre; -ere not standard

tie.why: et slips, plural slips (zero); builder over-applied -er

tights.why: plural field held the untranslated English word; strømpebukse -> strømpebukser

toe.why: tå has umlaut plural tær (en tå, tåa/tåen, tær, tærne)

tree.why: et tre (plant) plural trær (et tre, treet, trær); builder left s===p

turnip.why: kålrot = kål+rot; rot has umlaut plural røtter -> kålrøtter

walnut-tree.why: valnøttre = valnøtt+tre; tre plural trær -> valnøttrær; builder left s===p

weasel.why: snømus = snø+mus; mus has zero plural (mus) -> snømus; builder over-applied -er

suspenders.why: buksesele (m, mest i flertall) plural bukseseler; -ere is not a valid form (singular field already holds the plural picture label)

apron.why: 'forkle' is neuter: et forkle. Wiktionary Bokmål: 'forkle n'.

bow-tie.why: Head noun 'slips' is neuter (et slips). NAOB: 'et; slipset, slips'.

camera.why: 'kamera' is neuter: et kamera. NAOB: 'et; kameraet, kameraer'.

cash-register.why: Head noun 'apparat' is neuter (et apparat); kassaapparat → et kassaapparat. NAOB: 'et; apparatet, apparater'.

helicopter.why: 'helikopter' is neuter (et helikopter); builder default m is wrong. Plural 'Helikoptere' is valid ('helikoptre eller helikoptere').
helicopter.src: NAOB helikopter (et; helikopteret, helikoptre eller helikoptere; nøytrum)

glasses.why: s/p field 'Briller' from 'brille', which is maskulinum(femininum); DATA uses m/n so feminine->m. Neuter is wrong.

keyboard.why: 'keyboard' is neuter in bokmål (et keyboard); builder default m is wrong.

rain.why: NAOB regn: genus nøytrum (et; regnet). Builder default-skewed to m.

scarecrow.why: NAOB fugleskremsel: genus nøytrum (et). Head -skremsel is neuter. Builder mis-set to m.

sunglasses.why: brille is maskulinum (en brille); solbriller is not neuter

trapezoid.why: trapes as geometric shape is intetkjønn (et trapes); the masculine entry is the gymnastics apparatus/trapeze
